## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S2. This is audit backlog UX-11 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /nurse/:id → /consult/:id · nurse, doctor.
Findings and reviewers: F-16 · reviewer A-09. WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.7 Redundant Entry, across two users.
Rationale: The nurse typed Fever and sore throat for three days and saved. In the consultation, Chief complaint was empty and the text appeared nowhere. The doctor asks and types again.
Proposed UX behaviour: When the consultation opens and the doctor's Chief complaint is empty, it is prefilled with the nurse's text and marked from nurse intake with the nurse's name and time (the existing provenance tag). It is editable; once the doctor edits it, the text is the doctor's and the mark says edited by the doctor. A complaint the doctor already typed is never overwritten. The signed note records the source.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 9.
Components and tokens affected: NoteEditor chief complaint field; ProvenanceTag. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end; back end if the nurse's complaint is not yet stored or not exposed to the note.
Prerequisites and blocked by: None.
Clinical sign-off: Required before merge: question 8 of the validation plan (pilot doctor and nurse), recorded on the issue.
Effort and regression risk: S · Low. Unknowns stay blank: no complaint from the nurse means an empty field.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Prefilling any other note section. (2) AI drafting.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the nurse saved a complaint at intake, when the doctor opens the consultation, then Chief complaint holds that text with the mark from nurse intake
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the doctor already typed a complaint, when intake is saved later, then the doctor's text stays
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the prefilled text, when the doctor changes it, then the mark shows the doctor edited it and the signed note records both sources
- [ ] **AC4.** Given no complaint at intake, when the consultation opens, then the field is empty and nothing is guessed
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a screen reader, when the field is focused, then the source is read; axe finds no violation in English or Arabic
